checks.description: Minting must be guarded by an ownership check; any unguarded state write before an external call is reported.
totalSupply must be adjusted exactly on mint/burn; wrap-around arithmetic on ADD/SUB/MUL is flagged.
No state write (SSTORE) may precede an external call (CALL) without a guard.
Balance/allowance arithmetic must be checked for overflow.
Every CALL must be followed by a JUMPI success check.

boundary.note: The 19 constitutional invariants are compiled into the BoundarySystem axioms discharged by the canonical instance (no axioms, no sorry).
